data.message: Heading to navigation for my task, just came from weapons.

I found Frank's body in medbay just now. My route this round: storage → lower engine → upper engine → medbay. I saw Eve in upper engine at ticks 11-12, and she left toward lower engine at tick 13. I didn't see anyone else on my route. Frank was already dead when I entered medbay, so whoever killed him was in medbay recently and left before I arrived. Curious to hear where everyone else was — especially who was near medbay or cafeteria.

I was on the east side the whole round. My route was weapons → security → navigation → back to security. I was doing my tasks over there. I didn't see anyone in medbay or cafeteria area.

I did see Diana — she was in security with me and left toward navigation around tick 15. And right now Charlie and Diana are both here in security with me. I haven't seen Eve or Frank at all this round, and obviously didn't see Alice until the meeting.

So I can't confirm or deny much about medbay. Alice's story about Eve heading toward lower engine is interesting though — Eve would've had to come back up through upper engine or storage to reach medbay in time. I'd like to hear from Charlie, Diana, and especially Eve about their routes before pointing fingers.

My route was medbay → electrical → security → weapons → back to security. Here's what I saw:

At tick 4, I was in medbay and saw Eve there — she had just come in from electrical. So Eve was in medbay early in the round.

Then I moved to electrical, and at ticks 6, 7, and 8 I saw Frank there. He came in from security side. He was alive and seemingly doing tasks in electrical when I left.

After that I went to security, then weapons, then back to security where I saw Bob arrive from navigation at tick 15 — which matches Bob's story.

So a few things stand out: Eve was in medbay around tick 4, and Alice says Eve was in upper engine at ticks 11-12 heading to lower engine at 13. That's a wide gap. Eve could have looped back to medbay to kill Frank after Alice saw her leave toward lower engine — lower engine connects to storage which connects to medbay.

I really want to hear Eve's full route. She's the only one with confirmed proximity to medbay twice potentially.

Okay, let me lay out my full route honestly: I started in electrical, then went to medbay, then upper engine, then lower engine. That matches what Diana saw — yes, I was in medbay around tick 4, coming from electrical.

But here's the key thing: after medbay I went UP to upper engine, not back. Alice saw me in upper engine at ticks 11, 12, and 13 — she actually came INTO upper engine from lower engine at tick 11, so she can vouch I was there those ticks. Then I went to lower engine, where I've been since. I did not loop back to medbay.

Diana's theory that I could've gone lower engine → storage → medbay doesn't really work timing-wise — that's multiple ticks of travel, and Alice found the body in medbay shortly after. Alice was actually closer to medbay than I was after tick 13.

Also, I want to flag something: Diana says she saw Frank alive in electrical at ticks 6-8. I was in electrical before medbay, early in the round. Diana places herself in medbay at tick 4 then electrical after — so Diana was in electrical with Frank, and then her route takes her through security/weapons. But Diana also had a path back toward medbay potentially.

Honestly, Alice vouches for me at 11-13 in upper engine, and I went straight to lower engine after. I think Diana's deflection onto me is suspicious. I'd like to hear Charlie before voting, but I'm leaning Diana.

Alright, here's my route: navigation → storage → medbay → electrical → security. I was in medbay around tick 9 and I saw Frank there — he had just come in from electrical. He was alive when I left. So Frank was alive at tick 9 in medbay, which actually narrows the kill window: someone entered medbay after tick 9 and before Alice arrived.

That's an important data point. Diana, you said your route was medbay → electrical → security → weapons → back to security. When exactly were you in medbay? You said tick 4, but did you pass back through? Because medbay is central and on the way between a lot of places.

Eve, your alibi at upper engine 11-13 is corroborated by Alice, which is solid. And going upper engine → lower engine fits — you'd still be down there.

Alice — you came from upper engine to medbay. What tick did you actually enter medbay and find the body? That tells us the kill window precisely.

Right now I'm between Diana and Alice. Eve has the strongest alibi thanks to Alice's vouch. Bob's on the east side, consistent with what I saw — Diana was in security when I arrived. I want to hear those tick timings before I lock in my vote, but I'm leaning Alice or Diana.

Good questions, Charlie. Let me give the precise timing: I entered medbay at tick 15 and found Frank's body immediately — called the meeting at tick 16. So the kill window is between tick 9 (when Charlie last saw Frank alive in medbay) and tick 15 when I arrived.

My full tick-by-tick: I was in storage early, moved to lower engine, then upper engine where I arrived around tick 11 and saw Eve there at 11 and 12. Eve left toward lower engine at tick 13. I stayed in upper engine briefly then moved to medbay, arriving tick 15.

Here's what stands out to me now: Eve is cleared by my vouch for ticks 11-13, and she went DOWN to lower engine after — away from medbay. For her to kill Frank, she'd need lower engine → storage → medbay, which is 2+2 = 4 ticks minimum. She left upper engine at 13, so earliest she could reach medbay is tick 17. Body was found at 15. Eve is clean.

Diana, your route concerns me. You were in medbay at tick 4, then electrical with Frank at 6-8. After electrical you say security → weapons → security. But medbay is geographically between electrical and... a lot of things. Can you confirm the exact ticks you were in security and weapons? Because if there's a gap, you could have looped back to medbay between tick 9 and 15.

Bob's east-side route checks out with Diana's sighting of him at tick 15. Charlie's route through medbay at tick 9 establishes Frank alive then.

I'm leaning Diana right now. She had proximity to Frank in electrical, and her later route is the least corroborated near the kill window.

I already shared my route and what I saw in my first speech — east side the whole time, Diana with me in security, and Charlie and Diana here now.

Now that I've heard everyone, let me weigh in:

Eve's alibi at upper engine 11-13 is solid because Alice vouches for her, and the math checks out — Eve physically cannot reach medbay by tick 15 going lower engine → storage → medbay. That's 4+ ticks from tick 13. Eve is cleared.

Charlie places Frank alive in medbay at tick 9, so the kill window is tick 9-15.

Alice's route: upper engine → medbay, arriving tick 15. She had direct access to medbay at the kill time. But she's the reporter and her timing is consistent.

Diana's route is the one with gaps. Medbay → electrical → security → weapons → security. I can confirm Diana was in security with me and left to navigation at tick 15 — wait, actually I need to be careful here. Diana said she went security → weapons → back to security, and I saw her leave security toward navigation at 15. That's a small inconsistency, but maybe I'm misremembering the direction.

The bigger issue: Diana was with Frank in electrical 6-8, and electrical connects to medbay. If she looped back through medbay between her electrical visit and security, she had opportunity.

I'm leaning Diana too, but I want to hear her response to Alice's challenge about exact tick timings in security and weapons before I fully lock in.

Okay, I hear the suspicion on me, so let me give my exact tick timings:

Tick 4: medbay (saw Eve arrive from electrical)
Tick 5: moved to electrical
Ticks 6-8: electrical (saw Frank arrive from security at tick 6, he was doing tasks)
Tick 9: moved toward security
Tick 10-11: security (doing CheckCamera task)
Tick 12: moved to weapons
Tick 13-14: weapons
Tick 15: back in security, where I saw Bob arrive from navigation

Bob, to clarify — I went security → weapons → security. You saw me return to security at tick 15, not leave toward navigation. You arrived from navigation at 15. We were both in security at that point along with Charlie shortly after.

Here's the key point: my route from electrical at tick 8 goes electrical → security (2 ticks), so I arrived security around tick 10. From there I went east to weapons and back. I never went back west toward medbay. To loop back to medbay from security, I'd have to go security → electrical → medbay (2+2=4 ticks) or through cafeteria. There's no gap in my timeline that allows that — I was in security/weapons/security continuously from tick 10 to 15.

Frank was alive when I left electrical at tick 8. Charlie saw him alive in medbay at tick 9. That means Frank moved electrical → medbay between tick 8 and 9. Someone killed him in medbay between tick 9 and 15.

Who had access to medbay in that window? Not me (east side from tick 10). Not Eve (upper engine 11-13, vouched by Alice). Not Bob (east side). Not Charlie (he was IN medbay at tick 9 and left to electrical, then security).

Wait — Charlie, you said your route was navigation → storage → medbay → electrical → security. You were in medbay at tick 9 with Frank. You're the LAST person confirmed with Frank alive. And your path after medbay goes to electrical — but you could have stayed in medbay or returned. Where were you between tick 9 and when you reached security?

I'm now leaning Charlie. He had last contact with Frank and his post-medbay timeline needs scrutiny.

Okay, this is getting clearer. Let me respond to Diana's redirect onto Charlie, because I think it actually has merit but we need to be careful.

Diana's timeline now is detailed and internally consistent: electrical at 6-8, security 10-11, weapons 12-14, security 15. Bob corroborates her being in security at 15. That's a tight east-side alibi from tick 10 onward. For her to have killed Frank, she'd need to loop back west, and the travel times don't allow it.

Charlie's situation is genuinely concerning now that Diana raises it. Charlie says his route was navigation → storage → medbay → electrical → security. He was in medbay at tick 9 — the LAST person to see Frank alive. Then he claims he went to electrical and security. But Diana was in electrical until tick 8 and then security from tick 10 onward — so if Charlie went medbay → electrical after tick 9, Diana wouldn't have seen him there (she'd already left). And Charlie didn't mention seeing Diana in security either, even though Diana was there 10-11.

Charlie, can you confirm: did you see Diana in security when you arrived? What ticks were you in electrical and security? Because if you lingered in medbay after tick 9, you had the perfect opportunity — you were alone with Frank, last to see him alive, and medbay is your claimed location at the kill window's start.

I'm shifting my vote toward Charlie. Diana's timeline is corroborated by Bob; Charlie's post-medbay movements are the least verified, and he was alone with the victim at tick 9.

Alright, I hear the suspicion and I'll address it directly because I'd rather clear this up than dodge.

My exact ticks: I was in navigation early, moved to storage around tick 5-6, then to medbay arriving tick 9 where I saw Frank come in from electrical. I left medbay at tick 10 heading to electrical. I was in electrical ticks 11-12, then moved to security arriving around tick 13-14, and I've been here since.

To Eve's question: when I arrived in security, Diana was NOT there — she said she was in weapons 12-14, which matches. I saw Diana arrive back in security at tick 15, same as Bob's arrival from navigation. So Diana's east-side timeline actually checks out from MY perspective too.

Now here's the thing — yes, I was last to see Frank alive at tick 9. But I LEFT medbay at tick 10 and went to electrical. If I'd stayed to kill, why would I move to electrical where Frank had just come from? And the kill window is tick 9-15, which is 6 ticks. Plenty of time for someone else to enter medbay after I left.

Who hasn't been scrutinized? Alice. Her route: storage → lower engine → upper engine → medbay. She "found" the body at tick 15. But she was in upper engine which connects directly to medbay's neighbors. She has Eve as a vouch for upper engine 11-13, sure — but Eve being in upper engine doesn't mean Alice was there the WHOLE time. Alice could have dipped to medbay and back.

Also, Alice is the reporter. Classic move.

I'm between Alice and Diana, but leaning Alice. Diana's timeline is corroborated by Bob; Alice's is only corroborated by Eve for a narrow window.

I found Eve's body in security. I had just come back from navigation to finish my task there. My route this round was weapons, security, navigation, then back to security where I found her.

Earlier in the round I saw Bob in security at tick 15 — he was the last person I saw in that room before I left for navigation. When I came back, Eve was dead there.

With Alice already ejected last meeting and Frank/Eve both dead, that leaves me, Bob, and Charlie alive. I didn't see Charlie at all this round, but Bob being in security shortly before Eve died there is very suspicious to me. I'm leaning hard toward Bob.

This is bad for me. I need to think carefully.

3 alive: me (Charlie, Duck), Bob, Diana. I need majority — that means I need to get one of them voted out, leaving 1v1 which... wait, 1 Duck vs 1 Goose IS majority (1≥1). So I need to eliminate either Bob or Diana this vote.

Diana is pushing hard on Bob. If I pile on Bob, he gets voted out and I win (1 Duck = 1 Goose, ducks have majority).

I killed Eve in security at tick 20. My route puts me in security at that time. I need to lie about my route — say I left security before Eve arrived, or just downplay it. Actually Diana said Bob was in security at tick 15. I can corroborate being near there but claim I left.

Best play: support Diana, throw Bob under the bus. Get Bob voted out, I win.

"I was doing tasks around the upper part of the ship this round — cafeteria, then weapons to work on the task there, then back through cafeteria. I never went down to security or navigation, so I can't speak to what happened to Eve directly.

But Diana, what you're saying lines up with something. When I was passing through cafeteria heading to weapons, I'm pretty sure I saw Bob heading toward security side of the map earlier. And if you saw him in security at tick 15 and Eve ended up dead there shortly after — that's a really tight window.

I didn't see Bob kill anyone, obviously, but the timing you're describing is damning. I also haven't seen Bob do or report anything useful this round. I'm with you, Diana. My vote's going on Bob unless he can give us a route that clears him."

Hold on, both of you are pushing on me really hard and the story doesn't add up.

Diana, yes, I was in security earlier — I'll own that, my route was security, then electrical, then medbay. I left security and went west/through electrical to medbay. I was nowhere near security when Eve died.

Charlie, here's the problem with your speech: you said you were in "cafeteria, then weapons, then back through cafeteria" and that you saw me "heading toward security side of the map" from cafeteria. But to get from cafeteria to security I'd have to go through weapons or through medbay/electrical — and if you were in weapons, you'd have seen me directly, not "heading that way." Your story is vague in exactly the way a Duck's story is vague.

Also — Alice was ejected last meeting, and she was a Goose-call by us. If Alice was innocent, then the Duck is still here. Between Diana finding the body (which Ducks rarely do because self-reports are risky but possible) and Charlie giving a wishy-washy "I saw Bob heading somewhere" with no concrete encounters... Charlie has ZERO confirmed sightings of anyone. No one saw him. That's a Duck hiding.

I'm voting Charlie. Diana, please think carefully — if you vote me and I'm a Goose, Charlie wins outright next tick.

Okay, listening to both of you, I need to think carefully because this vote decides the game.

Bob, you make a strong point. Charlie, your speech bothered me too — you said you saw Bob "heading toward security side" from cafeteria, but the path from cafeteria to security goes through weapons. I was IN weapons this round, and I didn't see Charlie there. If Charlie was really in weapons working on a task, we should have crossed paths or at least seen each other.

Also — Charlie piling on Bob so eagerly with vague secondhand "I think I saw him heading that way" evidence is exactly the kind of bandwagon a Duck would push. Bob at least owned his route honestly and admitted being in security earlier.

Bob's route — security to electrical to medbay — is plausible and he didn't try to hide that he was in security. A Duck would more likely lie about being near the crime scene.

I'm reconsidering. Charlie hasn't been seen by anyone this round, his story about seeing Bob doesn't hold up against my time in weapons, and he's pushing way too hard to get Bob ejected. I think I was wrong to jump on Bob first.

I'm switching my vote to Charlie.

Hold on, Diana — you're flipping on a dime here and that's dangerous. Let me address the weapons thing directly.

Yes, I was in weapons briefly to tap the task there. If you were in weapons too, our timing just didn't overlap — you said your route was weapons, security, navigation, security. I was in weapons earlier in the round and left before you got there. That's not a contradiction, that's just two people passing through at different ticks.

And Bob — your route conveniently has you leaving security right before Eve dies there. "Security, electrical, medbay" — that's a clean story, but you're the one Diana actually placed at the crime scene. I'm the one nobody placed there because I WASN'T there when it happened.

Here's what bothers me about Bob's pivot: the moment Diana named him, he immediately redirected the entire meeting onto me with a "Charlie has no confirmed sightings" argument. That's classic deflection. Diana, you had a read. Your FIRST read. Bob was in security right before Eve died there. That hasn't changed just because Bob talks fast.

If you vote me and I'm a Goose, the Duck — Bob — wins next round anyway. Same risk both ways. But your original evidence pointed at Bob with actual placement at the scene. Trust your first read.

I'm voting Bob.

Diana, you had it right the second time. Let me lay it out clearly.

Charlie just said "I was in weapons briefly to tap the task there." But in his FIRST speech he said "cafeteria, then weapons to work on the task there, then back through cafeteria" AND that he saw me "heading toward security side." Now suddenly he was only there "briefly" and left before Diana arrived. His story is shrinking under pressure — that's a Duck adjusting.

More importantly: Diana, you were in weapons, then security, then navigation, then back to security. If Charlie was in weapons before you, fine — but then he claims he saw me heading to security from cafeteria. I never went through cafeteria this round. My route was security → electrical → medbay. I came up from security going WEST, not from cafeteria. Charlie fabricated a sighting of me that's geographically impossible given my actual route.

Diana, my being in security at tick 15 is real, but Eve died later and I was already in electrical/medbay by then. Charlie has no witnesses, his story contradicts itself, and he invented a sighting of me coming from a direction I never came from.

We've been wrong once already with Alice. If we're wrong again, we lose. But the evidence here points at Charlie — contradicting routes, fake sightings, and aggressive bandwagoning.

I'm voting Charlie.
